claims.explanation: Tyrphostin AG-99 is an EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor, and the most selectively killed lines are enriched for EGFR-mutant or EGFR-dependent lung adenocarcinoma (HCC4006, NCIH1650) and other lines with activated RTK/RAS/MAPK signaling (KRAS, BRAF, NRAS, HRAS, MAP2K1, MET, ALK). Sensitivity likely reflects dependence on EGFR/RTK-driven survival signaling, while resistance associates with intact PI3K/PTEN-AKT pathway activity and possibly NFE2L2/KEAP1-mediated oxidative stress protection. The pattern is not explained by TP53 status alone, since TP53 mutations are common in both sensitive and resistant lines.

features.basis: EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines HCC4006 and NCIH1650 are among the most killed; drug is an EGFR TKI
KRAS-mutant pancreas, colorectal, ovary, soft tissue, and lung lines appear enriched among sensitive lines, consistent with RTK/RAS/MAPK dependence
BRAF-mutant melanoma and colorectal lines UACC62 and SNUC5 are selectively killed
MAP2K1-mutant NCIH1437 is among the most sensitive lines, suggesting MAPK pathway dependence
NRAS-mutant KU1919 is selectively killed, consistent with RAS/MAPK-driven sensitivity
HRAS-mutant T24 bladder line is among the most killed
PTEN loss activates PI3K/AKT and appears in several less-affected lines (HEC265, ZR751, SUIT2, 8305C), suggesting reduced dependence on EGFR/RTK input
PIK3CA mutations are enriched in resistant lines (HGC27, HCC1954, HEC265), consistent with downstream PI3K activation bypassing RTK inhibition
NFE2L2 mutations appear in resistant lines TE6 and HEC265, suggesting antioxidant response protects against drug-induced stress
KEAP1 mutation in resistant HEC265 supports NRF2-pathway-mediated protection
MET mutation/amplification in resistant HGC27 and 8305C may provide bypass RTK signaling
ALK-mutant KELLY neuroblastoma is among the least affected lines, suggesting alternate RTK drive
